title: Koszul-regular and H_1-regular sequences
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, $r\ge0$, $f_1,\dots,f_r\in R$, and $M$ an $R$-module. Let $K_\bullet(f_1,\dots,f_r)$ be the Koszul complex of [def-weil-pbc-koszul-complex], a chain complex of $R$-modules (with $K_n=0$ for $n<0$ and $n>r$), let $K_\bullet(f_1,\dots,f_r)\otimes_RM$ be its tensor product with $M$ [def-weil-pbc-chain-complex-tensor-module] (terms $K_n\otimes_RM$, differentials $d_n\otimes\mathrm{id}_M$), and write $H_i(-)=\ker d_i/\operatorname{im}d_{i+1}$ for the $i$-th homology module of a chain complex of $R$-modules [def-weil-pbc-module-chain-complex-homology]. The sequence $f_1,\dots,f_r$ is called (1) *$M$-Koszul-regular* if $H_i(K_\bullet(f_1,\dots,f_r)\otimes_RM)=0$ for all $i\neq0$; (2) *$M$-$H_1$-regular* if $H_1(K_\bullet(f_1,\dots,f_r)\otimes_RM)=0$; (3) *Koszul-regular* if $H_i(K_\bullet(f_1,\dots,f_r))=0$ for all $i\neq0$; (4) *$H_1$-regular* if $H_1(K_\bullet(f_1,\dots,f_r))=0$.
